puzzle.hint: A military force or soldiers that provide support; a term for an army or troops.
puzzle.arabicVerse: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
puzzle.verse: 67:20 - Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
